title: Wastewater Concentration and Viral Pathogen Recovery Protocol
author: Joyce Akello
materials: MagMAX Wastewater Ultra Nucleic Acid Isolation kit
Select the MagMAX_Wastewater_DUO24 program on the KingFisher DUO

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Workspace
steps.instruction: Set up the filtration and sterilization equipment inside a Class II/A2 biological safety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the glass bead sterilizer and allow it to reach operating temperature.
Connect the EZ-Fit manifold to the EZ-Stream vacuum pump and plug the pump into a power source.
Connect the other side of the vacuum pump to a liquid waste pot/bottle containing virkon or bleach for disinfection.
Securely mount the EZ-Fit filtration unit onto the EZ-Fit Manifold Base with HTA Manifold Head.

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the wastewater sample for filtration.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the 40 mL wastewater sample by inverting several times.
Adjust the sample pH to 3.5 using hydrochloric acid, mixing thoroughly between titrations.

steps.title: Filter Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Concentrate the viral pathogens using the membrane filtration unit.

substeps.instruction: Verify the valve is in the horizontal (closed) position.
Remove the lid of the EZ-fit filtration unit and pour the 40 mL wastewater sample into the membrane filter.
Replace the lid and turn the valve to the vertical position.
Start the EZ-Stream vacuum pump and allow the liquid to flow into the waste container until filtration is complete.

steps.title: Recover Membrane Filter
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the membrane filter to a collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Remove the funnel, ensuring the membrane remains on the lower portion.
Spray two forceps with 70% ethanol and sterilize them by briefly submerging in the glass bead sterilizer.
Using both forceps, gently roll the membrane filter tightly (filter facing outwards) and place it into a labeled clean 2 mL tube.
If processing multiple samples, repeat the forceps sterilization for every sample.

steps.title: Lysis and Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Release nucleic acids from the filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of lysis buffer (MagMAX Wastewater Ultra Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit) to the tube containing the rolled filter.
Vortex vigorously for 30 seconds to 1 minute until the lysate is cloudy and brown.
Briefly centrifuge to collect contents.
Transfer the supernatant (lysate) to a clean 2.0 mL tube for immediate extraction (or to row A of a 24-deep-well plate for automated extraction).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and bead mixes for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 80% ethanol by diluting 100% absolute ethanol with nuclease-free water (minimum 4 mL per sample).
Prepare the Binding Bead Mix on the day of use by vortexing Binding Beads vigorously and combining components for the total number of samples plus 10% excess.
Mix the Binding Bead Mix well by inversion and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Automated Extraction (KingFisher Duo)
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction using the KingFisher Duo Prime system.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of lysate to row A of a new 24-deep-well sample plate.
Add 160 µL of Proteinase K to each sample well.
Invert the Binding Bead Mix and add 2,100 µL to each sample in row A using fresh tips for each addition.
Place a 6-tip comb into row B (Plate 1).
Add 4,000 µL of wash buffer to row C and 4,000 µL of 80% ethanol to row D (Plate 1).
Add 100 µL of elution buffer into row A of a separate 24 deep-well plate (Plate 2).
Cover plates with paraffin or MicroAmp Clear Adhesive Film.
Start the run and load Plates 1 and 2 when prompted.
At the end of the run (~28 minutes), immediately transfer the eluate to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Manual Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction manually using a magnetic stand.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL lysate to a clean 5 mL eppendorf tube and add 160 µL of Proteinase K.
Place on a magnetic stand for 3 minutes until beads collect on the side.
Close tubes and shake at 800 rpm for 30 seconds.
Remove from magnetic stand and add 4 mL of Wash Buffer.
Place on magnetic stand and carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing beads.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until beads collect.
Incubate the sample at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Shake for 5 minutes at 900 rpm on a shaker/mixer.
Invert Binding Bead Mix and add 2,100 µL to each sample using fresh tips.
Air-dry beads by leaving the tube open for 2 minutes.
Add 100 μL of Elution Solution to each sample.
Briefly centrifuge and remove any residual solution with a fine-tipped pipette.
Repeat the wash process (Wash Buffer/Ethanol steps) using 4 mL of 80% ethanol and discard supernatant on the magnetic stand.
Briefly centrifuge and place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes.
Incubate at 75°C for 5 minutes and shake at 800 rpm for 5 minutes.
Add 100 μL of Elution Solution and vortex vigorously to resuspend the pellet.
Transfer eluates to a new clean 1.5 mL tube using the magnetic stand.

steps.title: PCR Inhibitor Removal
steps.instruction: Remove inhibitors using the Zymo OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal Kit.

substeps.instruction: Insert a Zymo-Spin III-HRC Column into a Collection Tube.
Add 600 µl of Prep-Solution and centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes.
Transfer the prepared column to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µl total nucleic acid extract to the column and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the isolated nucleic acid on ice for immediate use or at −80 °C.
